cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: Good morning. You're through to the tourist information office, Tim speaking.

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: How can I help you?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Oh hello. Could you give me some information about next month's festival, please?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: My family and I will be staying in the town that week.

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: Of course. Well it starts with a concert on the afternoon of the 17th.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Oh I heard about that. The orchestra and singers come from the USA, don't they?

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: They're from Canada. They're very popular over there.

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: They're going to perform a number of well-known pieces that will appeal to children as

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: well as adults.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: That sounds good. My whole family are interested in music.

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: The next day, the 18th, there's a performance by a ballet company called Eustatis.

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: The name is spelt E-U-S-T-A-T-I-S.

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: They appeared in last year's festival, and went down very well.

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: Again, their programme is designed for all ages.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Good. I expect we'll go to that.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I hope there's going to be a play during the festival, a comedy, ideally.

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: You're in luck!

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: On the 19th and 20th a local amateur group are performing one written by a member of

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: group. It's called Jemima . That'll be on in the town hall.

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: They've already performed it two or three times.

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: I haven't seen it myself, but the review in the local paper was very good.

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: Yes, in fact it's aimed more at children than at adults, so both performances are in the

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: afternoon.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: And what about dance? Will there by any performances?

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: Yes, also on the 20th, but in the evening.

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: A professional company is putting on a show of modern pieces, with electronic music by

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: young composers.

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: The show is about how people communicate, or fail to communicate, with each other, so

cues.speaker: IM
cues.text: it's got the rather strange name, Chat .

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I suppose that's because that's something we do both face to face and online.
